The Defective Detective — Album 2: Serah Investigates

Chasing Shadows

"Chasing shadows Following what’s left behind"

[Verse] Van still parked beneath the light Engine cold No one in sight Same dark building Same dead street Three crushed cigarettes by Serah’s feet

Kamira crouches Camera raised “Lipstick matches yesterday.”

Click

Another angle Another frame

Serah doesn’t need to say the name

[Pre-Chorus] Lyra

Always one step out of sight Every answer leaves another Shadow running through the night

[Chorus] Chasing shadows Following what’s left behind Footprints Ashes Broken signals Little fractures in the line

Chasing shadows Every clue refuses rest But four sets of eyes see further

Than one defective detective ever guessed

[Verse] Coda’s underneath the dash Pulling camera memory cache Chip by chip She cracks the feed

“Someone wiped this.”

Serah: “Can you read?”

Coda smiles

“They tried.”

Nessa kneels beside the road Little scanner starts to glow Blue lines bloom across the dirt

“Tracks.”

Kamira asks “Does that thing work?”

Nessa answers “Better than Coda treats my hardware.”

Coda says “We’re not doing this again.”

[Pre-Chorus] Elf prints Goblin prints Something heavier beside

Then Nessa stops

“And hers.”

Serah doesn’t ask

She knows

Lyra

[Chorus] Chasing shadows Following what’s left behind Footprints Ashes Broken signals Little fractures in the line

Chasing shadows Every clue refuses rest But four sets of eyes see further

Than one defective detective ever guessed

[Verse] Andy’s quiet near the wall Too small beneath the building tall Then he bends Picks something free

One long strand caught underneath

His hands start shaking

“Mom.”

Serah kneels

“You’re sure?”

He nods

“I know her hair.”

No joke this time No clever line

Serah bags it carefully

“Then she was here.”

[Pre-Chorus] One more fact One more thread One more reason they were led

Not missing

Moved

And somewhere ahead

Still alive

Maybe

Please

[Chorus] Chasing shadows Following what’s left behind Footprints Ashes Broken signals Little fractures in the line

Chasing shadows Every clue refuses rest And suddenly this broken little team

Is terrifyingly efficient at its best

[Bridge] Serah checks the driver door

Nothing

Back seat

Nothing

Floor

Then underneath the passenger side

Folded paper tucked inside

She opens it

Reads once

Then twice

Kamira lowers the lens

Coda looks up

Nessa goes still

Andy waits

Serah reads aloud

[Break] “Don’t look for us.”

“Everything is fine.”

“Stay away, Serah.”

Then underneath

One name

Lyra

Serah laughs once

Cold

“Yeah.”

“No.”

[Pre-Chorus] Nessa checks the tracks again Circles narrowing at the end

“They stop here.”

Serah: “What do you mean they stop?”

“I mean…”

“They vanish.”

Elf Goblin Lyra too

Footprints ending with nowhere to move

[Chorus] Chasing shadows Now the shadows disappear No road forward No trail leaving No explanation anywhere

Chasing shadows Lyra says to stay away

Which is an incredibly effective method

Of making Serah stay

[Final Chorus] Chasing shadows Now the whole team starts to move Kamira photographs the message Andy guards the strand like proof

Chasing shadows Coda dives into the code Nessa scans the empty footprints

Serah studies every road

Chasing shadows Five minds pulling at the thread

Then Coda freezes at the console

“Wait.”

Everything goes dead

[Outro] Coda scrolls

Once

Twice

Internal Company mail

Correction schedule

Facility routing

Subject authorization

Her face changes

“Tomorrow.”

Serah turns

“What?”

Coda looks up

“Foxxie gets corrected tomorrow.”

Then behind them

Something drops

Nessa’s device hits the floor

Her ears rise

Her face goes pale

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“Foxxie?”

Serah looks at her.

“Nessa?”
